text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with possible asthma overlap. Given the two-month duration, exertional dyspnea, night worsening, and absence of fever or chest pain, infectious causes like pneumonia are less likely, and the lack of diagnostic testing limits confirmation of specific etiologies.
